why: Ambiguous transit signal from k=3's filmstrip: the yellow gate post fills frame 1 close-up on the left, but instead of the crossbar/second post growing and both sliding to frame edges, a plain white pillar takes over the same screen region in frames 3-5 against an office/desk backdrop -- not the clean grow-and-vanish-behind pattern I'd want for a confirmed transit, so I can't be sure we threaded the gap cleanly vs. skimmed past the post. Downward view shows a fluffy black/white blob on a mat square, but per the brief the target sits on a table, not bare floor matting, so I'm not treating this as the stuffed animal yet.
